description: Use this when the user wants to know who can make their uploaded parts and how fast: CNC machining, sheet metal, injection molding or wire harness. Asks Maglev's quoting shops in parallel, and the user's CAD file goes to them: shops in the US for every process, plus shops abroad for CNC machining and sheet metal and 3D-printed alternatives to injection molding (process 3d_printing). Nothing is sent to a shop until the part's requirements are met. Ask the user for the material; never choose one for them. Returns parts[], each with offers[] in one shape: process, ships_from (country), price_type (firm or budgetary), one_time_costs, lead_time_days, ships_by, dfm_warnings, quote_id. No shop name, price or link is shown before Maglev's own quote. We quote you one price for the build, fixed before you commit. Every number you pay is on that quote. To order, pass a quote_id to preview_order for the terms. For catalog parts, use build_rfq. Requires a Maglev API key.

file_ids.description: file_id values returned by the upload commands from upload_cad_for_quote

options.description: Per-file options: { file_id: { material, finish, tolerance, accept } }. material is required for CNC, sheet metal and molding and must be a value the shop lists, where it publishes a list. finish and tolerance are stated, or filled by accept: ["shop_standard"]. A response with readiness requires_input lists each missing field and its allowed values; fill them and call again. Ask the user for the material; never choose one for them. When a part is requires_input with its own requirements met, read suppliers[].requirements: they say what each supplier needs before it is asked. A part stays ready while one supplier can be asked: suppliers_dropped lists each supplier left out, with a code (cannot_be_told, not_offered, needs_input or unreachable), the field and the country it ships from (ships_from, null when not known), and how_to_fix says what would bring it in. Also accepted per file: quantity, speed, and for molding wall_mm and draft_deg.

processes.description: Optional per-file process override: { file_id: process }

quantity.description: Units per part, unless overridden per file in options.quantity

sort.description: How to order each part's offers. Default price.

name: get_quotes
title: Get manufacturing quotes from shops
